big: Buffalo's chance to win, our model (Chicago 43%)
How often tired road teams won when our model gave them 46%
note: Chicago creates the fewest chances in the NHL. But Buffalo played last night, and the model doesn't count that: road teams on the second night of a back-to-back have won 38% since 2023-24, against 47% when rested.

explainer.title: Every shot has a chance of going in.
explainer.text: A shot from within 10 feet went in 13.8% of the time over the last three seasons; from 60 feet or more, 0.8%. Add up those chances on every shot and you get what a team's chances were worth in goals.
